common_general_terms.source_note: Same English provisions read independently in both PDFs. Page references below apply to each contract. Main contract and signed Operation & SLA appendix are kept distinct.

acceptance.text: All works, services, supplies and deliverables are subject to the First Party's inspection, examination and acceptance. Acceptance requires its formal written approval. Nonconforming work/service/supply may be rejected and must be re-performed or rectified at no additional cost.

precedence.text: Documents and appendices are integral; if they disagree, terms of the Contract prevail. Arabic prevails over English in a language conflict. This extraction does not adjudicate conflicts or interpret the Arabic text.

amendments.text: Scope, quality and other amendments require mutual agreement, a written amendment signed by duly authorized representatives, and a mutually approved addendum.

performance_security.text: Final, unconditional and irrevocable bank guarantee from a bank operating within the State: 2% of total contract value. Starts on contract start date and remains valid 90 days after the contract period ends. Revocation requires First Party consent; return follows an approved certificate of completion.

general_sanctions.text: Failure to provide services/materials or exceeding the granted time limit permits legal action under Law 12 of 2020 and relevant UAE laws. Delay penalties/fines/measures are referred to that law; no numeric daily delay rate or service-credit cap is stated in these general clauses. An exemption for emergency, force majeure, First Party cause or other cause beyond supplier control requires supporting proof and First Party consent.

liability.text: Supplier indemnifies direct damages/losses and related claims arising from breach. Wording excludes indirect losses, consequential damages and lost profits, save damages arising from gross negligence, fraud or confidentiality breach. It then states compensation shall not exceed 100% of total contract value. Preserve this clause wording; it is not an express cap on SLA deductions, and the treatment of exceptions is not resolved here. Supplier remains liable for third-party performance.

setoff.text: First Party may offset/deduct from supplier payments sums, payments or claims owed under the contract or from supplier failure to perform.

termination.text: For breach: First Party may terminate if supplier does not rectify within 30 working days following written notice; supplier is liable for First Party costs caused by termination.
Early termination: First Party gives at least 30 days written notice and compensates the value of materials supplied/services rendered.

Additional grounds: fraud/manipulation/bribery conviction; bankruptcy/insolvency/liquidation preventing performance; substitution of supplier; inability to execute wholly or partly. First Party may call performance security, enforce at supplier expense and seek damages.

disputes.text: Seek amicable resolution. If unresolved 30 days after dispute arises, refer to both parties' senior management, whose decision is described as final and binding. Dubai law and applicable UAE federal law govern; disagreement is referred to Dubai Courts. Clause 18 also supplies operational escalation.

first_party_obligations.text: Pay according to contract; provide written instructions/directives/premises remarks; return performance security after approved completion certificate.

supplier_delivery_governance.text: Perform with diligence; obtain First Party written approval of nominated professionals; provide pre-approved qualified specialists and an alternative when the responsible person is unavailable; attend requested progress meetings; collaborate and supply relevant data without cost; consider written comments; maintain complete execution/obligation records and present them upon request; maintain necessary approvals, consents, permits, licenses and authorizations.

subcontracting_assignment.text: Subcontracting and assignment require First Party prior written consent. Notify subcontractor details/items; supplier retains liability, including joint liability with assignee/sub-party.

intellectual_property.text: Each party retains pre-existing IP. No acquisition of rights over other-party information/outputs/reports; use, licensing or transfer requires prior written consent or separate written agreement as applicable. Notify infringement. On expiry/termination, generated data/deliverables/documents/reports/information assets vest in First Party and must be returned or securely deleted, with written certificate.

confidentiality.text: Keep First Party information/data confidential; no use, disclosure or transfer without prior written consent. Duties survive expiry/termination. Public-domain/legal-disclosure exception requires First Party notification. Third-party service-provider agreements must require compliance.

security_controls.text: Security controls aligned to First Party requirements: ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 22301, ISR, DESC and applicable DESC Cloud Security Standard; additional relevant DESC standards; PCI DSS/equivalent if payment data is processed/stored. Follow classification-based storage/management requirements and relevant legal updates without additional cost to First Party.

cyber_incident_notice.text: Notify First Party in writing promptly and no later than 24 hours after an actual or suspected security/cyber incident; provide detailed nature/root-cause/corrective-action report under ISR and cooperate with investigation, mitigation and regulators. This is separate from the appendix RCA-after-resolution target.

return_deletion_exit.text: On expiry/termination or First Party written request, without undue delay return or irreversibly securely delete information/assets, copies, backups and extracts. Retain only as required by law/regulation and continue protection. Give certificate on request. At own cost support timely secure migration, commonly used machine-readable data access and exit procedures for continuity/transfer.

cloud_ai_data.text: Cloud use needs First Party and DESC approval; cloud for classified data must use DESC-certified CSP. AI use requires written disclosure and prior First Party approval, equivalent security/confidentiality/data/regulatory controls, written IP/licensing/model/data/output terms, and supplier review/validation before submission; undisclosed/unapproved AI is material breach. No First Party data may be stored, processed or transferred outside UAE without prior written approval and applicable DESC compliance. Personal data is limited to contract purposes and subject to applicable UAE law.

hse_continuity.text: Observe premises precautions, applicable Dubai HSE laws and relevant international standards for staff safety/environment/service continuity. Promptly report an epidemic disease affecting supplier staff who worked at First Party premises.

force_majeure.text: Written notice within 7 working days of force majeure and its impact; late notice disregarded. Supply supporting details and mitigation. Execution extension requires the stated notices/consent and First Party determination in consultation with supplier; resume obligations as feasible. No liability for attributable force-majeure delay; if execution becomes infeasible, termination by operation of law, preserving surviving clauses.

phase_postponement.text: First Party may postpone a phase if supplier is notified before that phase's specified commencement date under the notices clause.

relationship_and_conduct.text: Neither party acts as the other's agent/representative or may create commitments/obligations for it. Prior written consent is required to use the other party's name/logo; supplier must avoid damaging First Party reputation/goodwill, deliberate adverse acts and third-party IP infringement. Supplier warrants no actual/potential conflict of interest and must disclose one immediately; First Party may take action including termination without liability.

audit.text: First Party can audit compliance and request statements/reports/records; scope includes IT/security controls, ISR, DESC and ISO compliance. It may use a specialist third party; supplier supplies data/documents/facilitation without extra cost. This compliance-audit duty is distinct from an optional supplier system-audit service in the SLA appendix.

notices.text: Official notices to designated contacts may be delivered in person, registered mail, email, or mutually agreed means. Notify representative changes by email and appoint replacement.

escalation_rules.text: L1 Operational/Technical; L2 Supervisory/Functional; L3 Executive/Governance. Automatically escalate upon response/resolution breach or escalation trigger. Remains active until case/dispute closure; document by email/authorized ticketing. No waiver of remedies. P1 outage/major business impact/security-compliance risk: L2 immediately, then L3 if unresolved. P2 High significant impact/limited workaround: start L1 and escalate if SLA breached. P3/P4 noncritical: L1; escalate if repeated or SLA breached. No numeric per-level deadline/max closure duration is printed despite general references to specified/maximum timelines.
